item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a read-only seven-day census of the reckon ledger for the plan section on one repair per review round: how many reviews the ledger holds, how many carry findings, the repair rounds each finding-bearing review drew, and how each finding was answered with a commit or declined at a reason. item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk/repair-round-census.html; the diff 8626cdd..d5ff451 lists exactly that one file (1096 insertions) across the two commits, and the census authoring machinery (the script, the JSON, the fragment builders) lives in the run directory outside the repository.

justifications.durability: the census script is embedded in the committed fragment and also on disk in the run directory, so a later reader can re-run it against the same ledger, and the fragment is committed. Two residual weaknesses the node itself names or leaves: the round evidence lives in live pointers and advice files that promotion deletes, so a re-run after those reviewed runs promote will undercount rounds (recorded in the reviewed manifest as a follow-on: write repair_dispatch into the released run record); and the fragment's Method points at census-run2.log, which carries no header naming its revision, tree or command, so a reader following the fragment cannot tie the print to a revision.
justifications.evidence: the census reproduces exactly. An independent re-run at --end 2026-10-02T12:43:09Z returned identical headline fields and zero per-review differences against the committed census.json (734 reviews, 20 without a stored record, 664 finding-bearing, 1404 findings, dispositions 988/36/380, rounds 0:623 and 1:41). The fragment reconciles with the payload (86 round rows but 41 distinct reviews, 624 rows but 623 distinct zero-round reviews); its embedded script is byte-equal to repair_round_census.py; the known-present control (a-served-thread, 3 reviews) is confirmed by its resume-4-advice.txt naming its own blocking ids; and the durability claim (no committed ledger row carries the structured repair record) is confirmed, the only matches being prose and function-name substrings. Residual: the counts rest on live pointers and advice files, and the fragment's Method names a header-less print.
justifications.fit: the fragment follows the evidence-doc conventions (doctype, meta docs-project and plan-* tags, a sectioned body with the embedded script) and carries no plan label in code or prose beyond the mandated meta and the fragment path; the census script lives outside the tracked tree, and the fragment is well-formed HTML after the closing-tag commit.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the deliverable lands at the mandated path and is registered as evidence for the plan section; every headline figure (734 ledger rows, 664 finding-bearing, 1404 findings, dispositions 988 unanswered / 36 acted / 380 declined, rounds 0:623 and 1:41) reconciles across the fragment, census.json and an independent re-run. One mark off because the plan section's invariant (every finding answered, every finding-bearing review one round) is measured false over the population and the census reports the distribution rather than a satisfied section, which is the correct measurement and is stated candidly in the manifest.
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed commits change exactly one repository file, the mandated fragment (1 file, 1096 insertions). No source, test, plan or shared index path is touched, and the census's own authoring machinery lives in the run directory outside the repository.
